* Track market trends in specific categories (e.g., food delivery, e\-commerce, fintech, healthcare apps) to prioritize high\-potential segments.
* Initiate outbound contact with prospects via cold calls, WhatsApp, email, and LinkedIn — targeting founders, app owners, marketing managers, and business heads.
* Present our review and rating improvement service through structured sales calls, clearly articulating the business impact of low ratings and the value of our solution.
* Handle objections confidently and guide prospects through the decision\-making process.
* Negotiate pricing and close deals within the defined sales framework to meet monthly revenue targets.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date CRM with lead status, follow\-up schedules, and deal progress.
* Submit daily/weekly research summaries and sales activity reports to the reporting manager.
* Share market intelligence — recurring objections, competitor mentions, prospect pain points — to help sharpen the team's pitch and strategy.
* Coordinate with the internal delivery team post\-closure to ensure a smooth client handover.

Required skills :

* 1–4 years of experience in B2B sales, market research, telecalling, or digital marketing sales. Exceptional freshers are welcome to apply.
* Ability to independently conduct digital research and build targeted prospect lists using platforms like the Play Store, App Store, and Google Maps.
* Comfortable making 30–50 outreach attempts per day across calls, WhatsApp, and email.
* Strong communication and persuasion skills in English and Hindi; regional language proficiency is an added advantage.
* Analytical mindset — ability to read data (ratings, review counts, trends) and translate it into a compelling sales pitch.
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven, and comfortable working independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of CRM tools (Zoho, HubSpot, or even Google Sheets) is preferred.
* Basic understanding of how app stores, Google reviews, and online ratings impact businesses is a plus.

description:
**Location:** Delhi NCR  

Full\-time, On\-site (All Days Office)  

**Contract Duration:** 6–8 Months  

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor  

**Industry:** Medical Devices / Healthcare / Life Sciences Manufacturing

**About the Role**


We are looking for an experienced Compensation \& Benefits professional to join our client on an interim assignment for 6–8 months. This role will be responsible for driving end\-to\-end payroll governance, compensation operations, statutory compliance coordination, reporting, audits, and employee compensation support in partnership with an external payroll service provider and internal stakeholders.


The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in payroll operations, compensation administration, statutory processes, reporting, reconciliations, and financial accuracy, as well as the ability to independently manage multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll \& Compensation Operations**

* Manage end\-to\-end payroll coordination with the third\-party payroll vendor.
* Validate monthly payroll inputs and ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
* Conduct payroll validation, salary variance analysis, and net pay variance checks.
* Perform final payroll audits and ensure payroll accuracy before salary disbursement.
* Manage bank transfer validation, transfer advice, and bank file uploads on banking portals.
* Coordinate payroll\-related statutory compliance payments and timelines.
* Support payroll processing for interns and consultants.
* Handle employee compensation and payroll\-related queries effectively.

**Compensation Administration**

* Prepare and manage offer letters and increment letters.
* Support salary revisions, compensation structures, and related documentation.
* Manage reimbursement payments and lease\-related payments.
* Prepare salary provisions and salary journal vouchers (JV).
* Coordinate salary JV entries in SAP.

**Reporting, Reconciliation \& Compliance**

* Prepare MIS reports for HR and leadership stakeholders.
* Conduct monthly headcount reconciliations.
* Support quarterly activities including:


	+ Inventory loading data
	+ Audit schedules
	+ Cross\-charge reconciliations
	+ Gratuity valuation
	+ Leave provision calculations
* Support annual operating planning (AOP) activities related to compensation and manpower budgeting.
* Ensure proper documentation, audit readiness, and process compliance.

**Key Requirements**

* 8–15\+ years of experience in Compensation \& Benefits, Payroll Operations, or HR Shared Services.
* Strong expertise in payroll governance and vendor\-managed payroll environments.
* Experience handling payroll audits, reconciliations, salary variances, and statutory compliance coordination.
* Hands\-on exposure to SAP and payroll systems.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in an individual contributor setup.
* High attention to detail and strong process orientation.
* Prior experience in manufacturing, healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical devices, or similar regulated industries will be preferred.

title: Workday Data Migration, Conversion and Mapping Analyst
description:
Job title: Workday Data Migration, Conversion and Mapping Analyst


Job location: Hyderabad, Hub


Job type: Fulltime/Permanent


About Sanofi


At Sanofi, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. As a global healthcare leader, we are committed to transforming the practice of medicine by pursuing breakthrough science, building sustainable business models, and expanding access to our medicines and vaccines. Our people are at the heart of everything we do — and so is the data that powers our operations.

**About the job**


The Opportunity


This is an exciting opportunity to further develop your career in data migration and Workday by joining a newly created Data Migration team at a pivotal moment. With 80% involvement in complex global projects — including implementations, data migrations, reporting and visualization initiatives, data sharing agreements, and data foundation developments — this role will support mission\-critical data mapping and loading activities that directly impact business operations, M\&A success, and compliance.


You will work under the Data Migration and Conversion Lead and have an expertise in Workday and EiB loads.


Key Responsibilities


Data Mapping Support

* Assist in building and maintaining source\-to\-Workday field mappings for loads
* Support documentation of transformation logic, validation rules, and value conversions
* Learn and apply country\-specific data standardization approaches
* Support mapping activities under the guidance of senior analysts


Bulk Load Execution Support

* Assist in executing Workday bulk loads using EIB and approved tools
* Support design and validation of templates, sequencing, and dependencies
* Prepare loads for review by senior analysts
* Follow approved governance processes and standards at all times


Migration Delivery Support

* Support end\-to\-end migration execution including mock loads, reconciliations, and production loads
* Assist in maintaining migration playbooks and cutover plans
* Support test load execution and result validation
* Assist in reconciliations between source and target systems


M\&A Support

* Assist in assessing and mapping incoming HR data for acquisitions
* Support cleansing, transformation, and loading activities for acquired populations
* Support data extraction and separation activities for divestitures
* Contribute to Day 1 readiness preparation for employee data in Workday


Data Quality Assurance

* Perform basic pre\-load data quality checks
* Identify and escalate data quality issues to senior analysts
* Support Data Governance and Data Quality teams on remediation activities
* Assist in guarding the People Data Model via correct data preparation


Documentation \& Audit Support

* Assist in maintaining audit trails, reconciliation reports, and rollback procedures
* Support load documentation maintenance and compliance
* Assist with audit and compliance requirements

**About you**


Required Qualifications

* Education \& Experience: Bachelor's degree in information systems, Data Management, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field
* 2\-5 years of experience in data management, data analysis, or related roles
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Workday EiB and HCM Certified
* Experience working in team environments


Technical Skills

* Strong Python, Excel and data automation and manipulation skills required
* Worked with Informatica or other ETL tools
* Basic SQL knowledge would be beneficial
* Workday HCM knowledge and EiB load preparation and execution

title: Senior Associate - Talent Panning
description:

JOB ID: R\-244890 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: May. 14, 2026 CATEGORY: Human Resources
**Job Description**


Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**


Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will support hiring plan maintenance and help drive talent planning services across geographies. You will actively partner with HRBPs, Workforce Planning, and Talent Acquisition teams to enable timely recruitment activation for the right roles at the right time.

**Responsibilities:**

* Maintain a consolidated hiring plan dataset, including records management and the development of rolling global workforce plans.
* Reconcile and report hiring plan data, and communicate planned vs. actual requisition status to Hiring Managers and HR Business Partners.
* Support the rollout of a continuous recruitment process and related enhancements to hiring plan administration workflows.
* Partner with the analytics lead to ensure hiring plan data supports recruitment process dashboards.
* Lead data reconciliation with Organizational Design and Talent Acquisition teams to ensure hiring plan data aligns with organizational design plans of record and TA activity.
* Partner with hiring leads to provide hiring process guidance, support required actions, and serve as a point of contact for issue resolution and key deliverables.
* Support analytics dashboard and source data refinement while maintaining reports and dashboards for organizational design workflows.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Collaborate with team members and support ongoing process improvements as needed.

**What we expect of you**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 7\+ years of experience in Talent Planning, Workforce Planning, HR Operations, Recruitment Operations, or a related HR function


OR

* Master’s degree and 6\+ years of relevant experience
* Experience supporting hiring plan management, workforce data reconciliation, reporting, and recruitment coordination.
* Experience partnering with HRBPs, Workforce Planning, Talent Acquisition, and cross\-functional stakeholders in a global environment.
* Strong project coordination, stakeholder management, data accuracy, and analytical skills.

**Must\-Have Skills:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and HR/workforce planning tools.
* Experience in hiring plan management, reporting, and data reconciliation.
* Understanding of workforce planning, recruitment operations, and organizational design workflows.

**Soft Skills:**

* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong attention to detail and process orientation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Sound judgment when handling confidential data.
* Agile mindset and continuous learning orientation.

**What you can expect of us**


As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.


In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

**Job Title:** **Assistant HR IT Manager \- Global Mobility**

**Location: Bangalore**

**ABOUT UNILEVER:**


Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose\-led business. Work with brands that are well\-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.

**ABOUT BANGALORE HUB:**


Bangalore Hub is the global technology and operations engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. Bangalore Hub serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end\-to\-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-oriented Global Mobility Technology partner to join our team and play a key role in transforming our Global mobility processes into digital solutions. You will work closely with the HR, PEX teams at our global locations to understand their needs and challenges and then collaborate with the technology teams within HR IT and broader Unilever IT to design and implement innovative digital solutions that streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance employee experience.


This role will be responsible for the overall administration of Global mobility technology platform(s) for international assignees and expat payroll, managing enterprise\-wide design framework, implementation of updates brought about by periodic releases and changes required by the users in the Equus AssignmentPro or other Global mobility systems.


This also includes maintaining standards, impact assessment and solution recommendation. The HR IT business partner for Global mobility serves as Subject Matter Expert on Equus AssignmentPro and will provide support to any related modules and downstream systems.

**WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE**

* First point of contact for Global and regional HR team and UL vendors for new demands, change request or any support requirement for Global Mobility
* Setting up, configuring, and maintaining all objects related to Global Mobility in AssignmentPro. Establishing and maintaining tenant wide standards on managing objects related to global mobility.
* Ensures accuracy of global mobility setup to sustain integrity of Equus AssignmentPro as single source of truth system and support sustenance of data flow to other linked platforms
* Captures, reviews \& act upon, including testing \& assessing impact of periodic releases related to global mobility technologies
* Liaises with Global Process Owners on change impact
* Sets key performance indicators of the team and ensures that key responsibility areas are managed efficiently and excellently
* Actively works and supports resolution of issues escalated, managing incidents, tracking ticket status and partnering with support teams to resolve
* Identifies and recommends processes areas that could be simplified, improved or changed; to enhance user experience and drive simplification
* Provides support in maintaining training activities and materials, including user guides, FAQ, recorded demos, portal content, etc.
* Plans projects that address business needs, and assess fit of new global mobility applications and vendors
* Support all global mobility integrations for any new demand, change request or trouble shooting
* Impact Assessment on payroll and rewards for any changes in AssignmentPro or any related application
* Liaises between HR and IT teams and supports HR business during project and BAU
* Ensures requirements and test plans are signed off in projects
* Ensures requirements by HR and IT are understood by both parties before any change or project
* Takes up IT project management role if there is no dedicated project manager in projects
* Works with HR team for user acceptance testing and ensure stakeholders are ready for go\-live
* Works on various KRAs for global mobility programs
* Assess global mobility processes and suggests automation opportunities
* Ensures that new vendors meet local and global Unilever standards and strategy.
* Supports business in vendor transitions.
* Implements new global mobility integration projects between global mobility technology platforms such as AssignmentPro and various systems such as Workday and Payroll systems
* Works with Data Privacy Team, Vendor Risk Management team and Cybersecurity team to ensure that new projects meet company standards
* Works with Enterprise Architecture to ensure that new projects are aligned with global technology strategy

**EXPERIENCES \& QUALIFICATIONS**

*Necessary Experience \& Qualifications*

* Education: A bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Experience: 7\+ years of overall experience in HR technologies
* Technical Skills: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Equus AssignmentPro. Payroll experience is good to have.
* Project Management: Project management experience, including the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

*Preferred Experience \& Qualifications*

* Project Management: Experience managing timelines, deliverables, and coordinating multiple work streams is beneficial.
* Knowledge of agile methodologies and experience working in agile environments.
* Knowledge of AssignmentPro and other HR systems in the domain of Global Mobility and payroll
* Strong knowledge of end\-to\-end Global Mobility HR processes, payroll, compensation and benefits and ability to define dependencies and connect the dots across the technology landscape.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Outstanding analytical, problem solving and fact\-finding skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate solution design, design proposals and negotiate options with stakeholders
* Ability to understand the HR’s business problem, need, or opportunity and to design a solution that completely and correctly addresses the need.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
* Ability to identify, clarify and resolve project issues and risks as needed.
* Strong relationship building skills to effectively partner with HR CoEs and other internal teams and external vendors.
* Ability to manage time and resources efficiently and effectively.
* Ability to work independently.

**SKILLS**

* Equus Assignment Pro
* International Assignments
* Expat Payroll
* Change Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Collaboration
* Customer Centricity
* Data Driven Decision making
* Digital Technology awareness
* Product Delivery
* Project Management

**LEADERSHIP SKILLS**

* **Unilever Behaviors** \[highlight the 2 most important for this role]


	+ **PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE:** Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed.
	+ **PERSONAL MASTERY:** Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
	+ **TALENT CATALYST:** Invests in people – coaches individuals and teams to realize their full potential. Creates an inclusive climate, empowering everyone to be at their best. Inspires powerful teamwork and collaboration, connecting people for better results.
	+ **CONSUMER LOVE:** Brings the voice of the consumer into everything we do, always.
	+ **BUSINESS ACUMEN**: Creates opportunities for profitable growth through the core and beyond.

So apply to us, to unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make the world a better place. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you!

description:
**Job Title:** Strategic Workforce Planning Analyst

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Job Type:** Permanent, Full Time


**Remote Working:** Hybrid

 **Our Team**


We're an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

 **About the Job**


As Strategic Workforce Planning Analyst within our People Insights \& AI team, you'll play a critical role in shaping how Sanofi plans its workforce future. Reporting to People Insights Partnership Leader, you'll work closely with our Strategic Workforce Planning (SWP) team on day\-to\-day delivery — building scenarios, optimizing Visier Planning, and producing cross\-functional insights that drive smarter decisions. This is a specialist role based in Hyderabad, focused on driving workforce insights across 7 Organizational Developments (ODs) while building capability in business users to become self\-sufficient. Over time, you'll also have the opportunity to partner with our Data Science \& AI team to sharpen and automate workforce analytics.

 **Main Responsibilities**

* Build, validate, and iterate workforce scenarios across 7 Organizational Developments to inform short\-term Operational Workforce Planning and Strategic (SWP)Workforce Planning decisions, turning complex cross\-Organizational Development data into clear, actionable recommendations for business stakeholders
* Drive Visier Planning improvements and optimization — not just operating the platform, but actively enhancing it to deliver better insights and efficiency
* Apply SWP methodology consistently across the organization, including scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, and workforce cost modeling
* Enable ODs and People Business Partners to become self\-sufficient in Visier Planning and SWP, building lasting capability rather than reliance on the SWP team
* Collaborate with the People Insights Partner team across COE topics (skills, talent, D\&I, compensation, and more) ensuring workforce planning is connected to and reinforces broader people strategy
* Partner with the Data Science \& AI team and SWP leads to identify opportunities to sharpen or automate workforce analytics, contributing to continuous innovation

**About You**

**Experience:**

* Demonstrated expertise in strategic workforce planning and people analytics, with proven ability to translate complex HR data into actionable business insights that drive organizational strategy.
* Hands\-on experience in emerging platforms— focused on Visier improvement and optimization beyond day\-to\-day use
* Demonstrated ability to train and enable business users — comfortable upskilling others, not just producing analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong scenario modeling skills: workforce cost modeling, headcount planning, and sensitivity analysis
* Proficiency in data visualization and storytelling to translate complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights
* Familiarity with emerging technologies and AI\-enabled analytics platforms

**Education:**

* Degree in Human Resources, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)


**Soft Skills:**

* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including with global and cross\-functional teams
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across organizational boundaries
* Curiosity and drive to continuously improve tools, processes, and analytical frameworks

**Languages:**

* Fluent English (written and spoken) required

**Why Choose Us**

* Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life\-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet
* Work at the intersection of workforce strategy and cutting\-edge analytics — using Visier Planning to shape how a global biopharma company plans its talent future
* Drive Progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably
* Build real capability across the organization — your work won't just produce insights, it will empower teams to think and act more strategically about their workforce
* Grow into data science — this role offers a genuine long\-term trajectory toward workforce data science and advanced analytics, with active support from the team
* Advance your career through stretch roles, cross\-functional moves, and development opportunities designed to match your ambition
* Thrive in inclusive, high\-performing teams where every role matters and every voice helps shape what's next

title: HR Operations Analyst
description:
Netgear is looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive HR Operations professional to manage end\-to\-end people operations for our India offices. This role is central to delivering a seamless employee experience \- spanning onboarding and offboarding, payroll and benefits administration, employee relations, statutory compliance, and general administrative oversight. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a high\-ownership environment, is comfortable working across functions and geographies, and brings a structured approach to managing multiple operational priorities simultaneously. This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact, requiring strong cross\-functional coordination with Finance, Legal, IT, and global HR teams.


This is a hybrid role that requires in office attendance 3 days a week in either Bangalore or Chennai.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Onboarding \& Offboarding**

* Coordinate pre\-boarding documentation including ID proofs, educational certificates, and background verification data.
* Set up new employees in HRIS across India and global systems, ensuring data accuracy and timely completion.
* Facilitate HR onboarding sessions for new joiners, covering employee benefits, policies, and key HR processes.
* Conduct HR orientation sessions covering benefits briefings, policy walkthroughs, and compliance training for all new joiners.
* Manage end\-to\-end resignation workflows including exit interviews, experience letters, and relieving formalities.
* Provide timely inputs for background verification requests related to ex\-employees.

**Payroll \& Benefits Administration**

* Collect and validate monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leave records, pay changes, and loss\-of\-pay deductions.
* Coordinate with Finance and payroll vendors to ensure accurate and timely salary processing each cycle.
* Manage employee insurance administration, including handling queries, coordinating with vendors, and processing monthly additions and deletions.
* Maintain statutory registers and support statutory filings including PF, PT, and Shops \& Establishment compliance.
* Liaise with labour law consultants on audits, inspections, and compliance updates.
* Oversee POSH compliance including Internal Committee (IC) constitution, employee awareness training, and annual reporting.

**Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Manage leave and attendance systems and maintain up\-to\-date holiday calendars for all India offices.
* Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employee queries on policies, payroll, benefits, and general HR processes.
* Issue employment\-related letters including salary certificates, employment verification letters, and visa support documentation.

**General Administration Support**

* Manage India\-specific HR and administrative vendors including background verification agencies, insurance brokers, payroll providers, and facilities partners.
* Track and maintain vendor service agreements, renewal timelines, and performance metrics.
* Plan and execute company events, training logistics, employee welfare programs, and engagement activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 4–8 years of experience in HR operations, with strong exposure to payroll administration, statutory compliance, and employee lifecycle management.
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms and payroll software used in India\-based operations.
* Solid understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory requirements including PF, PT, Shops \& Establishment, and POSH.
* Proven ability to manage vendor relationships and track service agreements across multiple functions.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage high\-volume, deadline\-driven payroll and compliance processes.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively across employee levels, functions, and geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing demands, and drive outcomes independently.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite, particularly Excel, and familiarity with HRIS/HRMS tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a multinational or technology company, coordinating with global HR teams.
* Prior exposure to managing India\-specific benefits renewals and insurance broker relationships.
* Experience supporting or leading POSH Internal Committee (IC) processes.
* Background in supporting facility operations or office administration alongside core HR responsibilities.

**Company Statement/Values:**


At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.


We're a performance\-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world\-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the *Next Gear* by living our values: we **Dare to Transform** the future, **Connect and Delight** our customers, **Communicate Courageously** with each other and collaborate to **Win It Together**. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.


We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward\-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

* Reporting and Analysis: Track and report on training metrics, such as completion rates and knowledge retention, to demonstrate the impact of training initiatives
* Support and Guidance: Provide ongoing support and guidance to employees, helping them apply new skills and knowledge in their roles
* Compliance and Standards: Ensure all training programs comply with industry standards and regulatory requirements


**Measures of Success**
* Training Attendance Rate: The percentage of employees who attend scheduled training sessions
* Course Completion Rate: The percentage of employees who complete the training programs they start
* Average Time to Completion: The average time it takes for employees to complete training programs
* Post\-Training Assessment Results: Scores from assessments conducted after training to measure knowledge retention and understanding
* Learner Satisfaction Rate: Feedback from employees on their satisfaction with the training programs, often gathered through surveys
* Learner Retention Rate: The percentage of knowledge and skills retained by employees over a specified period after training
* Job Performance Impact: The improvement in job performance metrics, such as productivity or quality of work, following training
* Training ROI (Return on Investment): The financial return generated from training investments, calculated by comparing the cost of training to the benefits gained
* Reduction in Skill Gaps: The decrease in identified skill gaps within the organization as a result of targeted training initiatives
* Training Program Quality: Regular evaluation of training content and delivery methods to ensure they meet high standards
* Business Stakeholder feedback
* Project Completion Timelines

* Learning Management Systems (LMS): Proficiency in using and managing LMS platforms to deliver, track, and report on training programs
* Awareness of Instructional Design and Content Development tools, models and best practices
* Assessment and Evaluation: Competence in creating and administering assessments to measure training effectiveness and employee learning outcomes
* Data Analysis and Reporting: Ability to analyze training data, generate reports, and use insights to improve training effectiveness
* Project Management: Experience in planning, executing, and overseeing training projects to ensure they are completed on time and within budget
* Facilitation Skills: Strong skills in facilitating both in\-person and virtual training sessions, ensuring they are engaging and effective
* Change Management: Understanding of change management principles to effectively implement and manage training initiatives
* Behavioral Training Techniques: Proficiency in techniques for conducting behavioral training sessions, such as role\-playing, simulations, and interactive activities
* In\-depth Cards Domain Knowledge across functions \& Working knowledge of any CRM would be an added advantage

* Managing Conflicts and dealing with difficult situations

description:
**Your potential, unleashed.** 




  





 India’s impact on the global economy has increased at an exponential rate and Deloitte presents an opportunity to unleash and realize your potential amongst cutting edge leaders, and organizations shaping the future of the region, and indeed, the world beyond.
 



  





 At Deloitte, your whole self to work, every day. Combine that with our drive to propel with purpose and you have the perfect playground to collaborate, innovate, grow, and make an impact that matters.
 



  





**The team** 




  





 You’ll partner with Enabling Area / AI Team to unlock value from data and AI through modern analytics and GenAI capabilities (e.g., RAG, LLM integrations) and strong delivery practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 • Lead stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs to elicit and document functional/non\-functional requirements (BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
 



 • Perform gap analysis, feasibility assessments, and traceability from business goals to product features.
 



 • Shape product vision and roadmap for AI features; prioritize backlogs based on value, feasibility, and risk.
 



 • Run Agile ceremonies (refinement, sprint planning, reviews) and maintain clear release plans and OKRs.
 



 • Translate use cases into LLM/GenAI solutions (e.g., retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt engineering, evaluation criteria) with DS/ML engineers.
 



 • Coordinate data availability, model monitoring, and governance (security, privacy, cost/performance) with platform teams.
 



 • Demo increments, validate requirements, and manage UAT with business users; drive adoption and training assets (playbooks, guides).
 



 • Communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership; support post\-launch analysis and continuous improvement.
 



 • Maintain clear artefacts (journey maps, process flows, personas, wireframes) and QA/test plans in partnership with QA leads.
 



  





**Qualifications**




 • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or Business; MBA is a plus.
 



 • Experience: Typically, 3–5 years in Product/BA roles.
 



 • Core: Proven requirements management, backlog ownership, and Agile delivery with enterprise stakeholders.
 



  





**Skills (Must\-have)**




 • Strong BA toolkit (elicitation, analysis, documentation, UAT).
 



 • Product tools (Jira/ADO/Confluence), and proficiency in MS Office for analysis and communication.
 



 • AI literacy: familiarity with LLMs/GenAI concepts, RAG patterns, evaluation/guardrails, and data governance.
 



 • Collaboration across Data Science, Engineering, UX; excellent stakeholder communication.
 



  





**Preferred Exposure**




 • Hands\-on with prompt design, GenAI evaluation, vector databases, or model lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring).
 



 • Experience in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and modern data/ML tooling.
 



  





**Success Metrics (KPIs)**




 • Requirement lead time (from intake to signed\-off user stories), backlog health, and sprint goal attainment.
 



 • Feature adoption (usage, satisfaction), model performance \& cost (for AI features), and defect escape rate/UAT pass\-rate.
 



  





**Working Model**




 Hybrid, with flexibility for stakeholder workshops, demos, and UAT at office/client sites as needed.
 



  





**How you’ll grow** 




  





***Connect for impact***




  





 Our exceptional team of professionals across the globe are solving some of the world’s most complex business problems, as well as directly supporting our communities, the planet, and each other. Know more in our Global Impact Report and our India Impact Report.
 








***Empower to lead***




  





 You can be a leader irrespective of your career level. Our colleagues are characterised by their ability to inspire, support, and provide opportunities for people to deliver their best and grow both as professionals and human beings. Know more about Deloitte and our One Young World partnership.
 








***Inclusion for all***




  





 At Deloitte, people are valued and respected for who they are and are trusted to add value to their clients, teams and communities in a way that reflects their own unique capabilities. Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive. At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.
 



  





***Drive your career***




  





 At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. We recognise there is no one size fits all career path, and global, cross\-business mobility and up / re\-skilling are all within the range of possibilities to shape a unique and fulfilling career. Know more about Life at Deloitte.
 



  





**Everyone’s welcome… entrust your happiness to us** 




  





 Our workspaces and initiatives are geared towards your 360\-degree happiness. This includes specific needs you may have in terms of accessibility, flexibility, safety and security, and caregiving. Here’s a glimpse of things that are in store for you.
 



  





**Interview tips** 




  





 We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared, confident and comfortable. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research, know some background about the organisation and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

title: Manager - HR Operations/Shared Services
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
 We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast\-track your career.
   

  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in\-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in\-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment


**About The Role**
 The role is accountable for managing the delivery of complex employee lifecycle services across the assigned region. This role leads a team of Tier 2 Specialists and Subject Matter Experts who handle escalated, policy‑driven, and country‑specific HR cases. The leader ensures timely and high‑quality resolution of advanced issues, maintains consistency in process execution, and collaborates closely with HR Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, and Tier 1 teams to enable seamless end‑to‑end service delivery.
   

  

 In addition, this role plays a critical part in enhancing regional HR service capability through robust process governance, compliance oversight, continuous improvement initiatives, and effective use of technology to drive efficiency, accuracy, and service excellence.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Lead Tier 2 service delivery across the designated region, overseeing complex employee lifecycle activities and escalated case management.
   

  

 Manage Tier 2 Specialists and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across key service lines, including but not limited to:
   

  

* Benefits operations
* Plant employee onboarding
* Offboarding processes
* Compliance and regulatory processes
* Data uploads, data management, and reporting
* Local policy‑driven exceptions
* Case escalations and investigations from Tier 1,Ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant execution of advanced HR processes.


**Operational Excellence \& Governance**
* Establish Tier 2 service standards and ensure adherence to country‑specific policies, regulatory requirements, and global HR frameworks.
* Oversee the investigation, documentation, and resolution of complex policy and employee lifecycle cases.
* Ensure end‑to‑end compliance across all Tier 2 processes, including audit readiness and risk mitigation.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to ensure correct policy interpretation and application.


**Technology \& Workflow Management**
* Support the execution of Tier 2 processes through Workday (system of record) and ServiceNow (case management).
* Define and refine Tier 2 workflows, escalation paths, and approval structures.
* Collaborate with HR Technology teams to leverage automation, AI, and workflow optimization to improve efficiency and accuracy.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a subject‑matter escalation point for Tier 1 teams, COEs, and HR Business Partners.
* Partner closely with Tier 1 leaders to ensure effective case handoffs, consistent knowledge content, and accurate case routing.
* Provide insights and feedback to COEs to support policy refinement and process standardization.


**Performance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and manage Tier 2 SLAs, KPIs, quality metrics, and process compliance indicators.
* Track key performance measures, including case complexity, cycle time, first‑time accuracy, and employee experience outcomes.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance service quality.
* Drive operational maturity and continuously elevate Tier 2 capabilities year over year.


**People Leadership**
* Coach, mentor, and develop Tier 2 Specialists and SMEs to build strong functional and policy expertise.
* Foster a culture of accountability, quality, and continuous learning within the Tier 2 team.
* Report to the Regional People Capability Centre Hub Leader and lead a team of Specialists/SMEs responsible for managing country‑specific and complex HR processes.
* Oversee the delivery of escalated queries, investigative requests, data uploads, technical troubleshooting, Workday support, and reporting activities.
* Manage specialized service lines, including Benefits Operations, Onboarding, Offboarding, Compliance, and other regulated or high‑complexity HR services.
* Collaborate closely with Tier 1 Team Leaders, Centers of Excellence (COEs), HR Business Partners, Legal, and HR Technology teams to ensure aligned, compliant, and high‑quality HR service delivery across the employee lifecycle.


**What You Need To Be Successful**
* 12\+ years of experience in HR operations or shared services, with demonstrated exposure to Tier 2 or SME‑level HR service delivery.
* Strong expertise in complex employee lifecycle processes, compliance requirements, and country‑specific HR policies.
* Hands‑on experience with HRIS platforms such as Workday and ServiceNow.
* Experience handling escalations, case investigations, and advanced policy interpretation.
* Experience working with multi‑country or regionally distributed teams.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, advise stakeholders, and recommend process improvements.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage senior partners.
* Proven leadership experience managing specialists or SMEs within a service delivery environment.


**Bonus Points if You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Management, or a related field.
* Experience implementing or enhancing ServiceNow workflows.
* Experience setting up or scaling Tier 2 teams in an HR shared services environment.
* Continuous Improvement certifications (Six Sigma, LEAN, Operational Excellence).
* Exposure to Works Council or regulatory consultation processes (if applicable to the region).


**What We Offer**
* Flexible work environment, allowing for full\-time remote work globally for positions that can be performed outside a HARMAN or customer location
* Access to employee discounts on world\-class HARMAN and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)

title: Team Member -Employee Relations- Chennai
description:
**Job Summary**
 The HR \- ER Compliance Manager – Zonal will be responsible for Employee Relations and compliance across assigned branches within the zone for the Gold Loans business. The role ensures adherence to statutory labour laws, company policies, audit requirements, and ethical HR practices. The incumbent must be comfortable with frequent travel to branches for audits, investigations, and compliance monitoring.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:** 
**1\. HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure 100% statutory compliance across branches (Shops \& Establishment Act, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, PF, ESI, CLRA, POSH, etc.).
* Conduct periodic HR compliance audits across branches.
* Maintain updated compliance trackers and documentation.
* Coordinate with legal and compliance teams for statutory filings and inspections.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR and labour compliance.


**2\. Employee Relations (ER)**
* Manage employee grievance handling and resolution within defined timelines.
* Conduct disciplinary inquiries and domestic investigations where required.
* Support HRBP in handling misconduct, absenteeism, and performance issues.
* Ensure proper documentation of warning letters, charge sheets, and termination processes.
* Promote a positive employee relations climate across the zone.
* Monitor adherence to code of conduct and ethical standards.
* Partner with Business HR to address Employee issues.
* Oversee background verification and employee documentation.


**3\. POSH \& Workplace Conduct**
* Ensure compliance with POSH regulations across branches.
* Support IC inquiries and conduct awareness sessions.


**4\. Travel \& Field Engagement**
* Conduct regular branch visits across the assigned zone.
* Perform surprise compliance checks and employee engagement meetings.
* Be available for urgent ER matters and statutory inspections.


**Key Skills \& Competencies:**
* Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in Employee Relations and disciplinary processes.
* Investigation and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong documentation and audit management skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the zone.

title: Data Scientist, Demand Planning and Workforce Intelligence
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Selling Partner Services (SPS) team's mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic e\-commerce marketplaces in the world, with nearly 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in ten countries. SPS safeguards every financial transaction across all Amazon sites. As such, SPS designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimize risk and maximize trust in Amazon.com. SPS organization is looking for a Data Scientist for its Forecasting and Planning Research team. The team is being grown to provide insights about its SPS planning and provide analytical solutions to help drive operational efficiencies, uncover the hidden risks and trends, reduce investigation errors and bad debt, improve customer experience and predict \& recommend the optimizations for future state of SPS operations.
   

  

 As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights and identifying opportunities through the use of statistical, machine learning, algorithmic, data mining and visualization techniques, with a strong emphasis on leveraging Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to drive innovation. You will develop and deploy Gen AI\-powered solutions for intelligent forecasting, automated pattern recognition in variance analysis, and conversational AI interfaces for operational dashboards. The role requires building agentic AI systems that enable natural language querying, automated root cause analysis, and intelligent recommendation engines for workforce optimization and resource planning. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. The candidate should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources and analytical techniques—including transformer architectures, foundation models, and prompt engineering—to answer a wide range of high\-impact business questions and present the insights in concise and effective manner. Additionally, the candidate should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non\-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impacts the bottom line of the business.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
* 1\+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
* 1\+ years of data/research scientist, statistician or quantitative analyst in an internet\-based company with complex and big data sources experience
* 1\+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
* Knowledge of statistical packages and business intelligence tools such as SPSS, SAS, S\-PLUS, or R
* Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem\-solving
* Experience with clustered data processing (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Map\-reduce, and Hive)
* Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
* Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data\-driven business decisions
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

title: Junior AI Engineer – Testing & Development (AI Codes, You Value Add)
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Junior AI Engineer – Testing \& Development (AI Codes, You Value Add)
 



 (Please do not apply if you want to code)
 



**Company:** 
 Innotechwise Private Limited (DPIIT\-recognised) — sister entity of Futuryntix UK Ltd
 



**Location:** 
 Remote / Work From Home (India)
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 years (Freshers with strong AI projects welcome)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 **CTC:** 
 Based on skills demonstrated in interview
 



  





**About Us** 




 Innotechwise and Futuryntix are building AI\-native enterprise products for supply chain, warehousing, and regulatory compliance. Our portfolio includes CircleIQ (an AI\-driven EPR compliance platform) and AI agents for enterprise operations. We build using modern AI\-assisted development workflows — Claude Code, Codex, and similar coding agents are core to how we ship. We are a small, founder\-led team backed by 20\+ years of SAP and enterprise experience, now building cloud\-native AI products on AWS. You will work directly with the founder.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior AI Engineer who lives and breathes LLMs — someone who has already made coding agents like
 **Claude Code** 
 and
 **OpenAI Codex** 
 a daily habit, knows their quirks, and can talk fluently about what they do well and where they fail. Your job will be to test our AI products, push them to their limits, and create content that shows the world what AI\-native engineering looks like. Half your week will be hands\-on testing of AI agents and LLM workflows; the other half will be creating demos, screen recordings, and content that explains our products to customers.
 



 This role is perfect for a fresher or early\-career engineer who is already using AI agents to build things, who is curious about how AI systems behave under pressure, and who wants to grow inside an AI\-native startup.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 Testing (≈50%)
 


* Test our AI agents and LLM\-powered workflows; document where they shine and where they break.
* Use Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents to rapidly build test harnesses, mock data, and edge\-case scenarios.
* Stress\-test prompts and agent flows with adversarial inputs — and log them clearly.
* Compare outputs across different models, prompts, and agent configurations.
* Maintain a library of test scenarios drawn from real enterprise use cases.
* Reproduce bugs reported by users and share clean reproduction steps.



 Content \& Demos (≈50%)
 


* Record short demo videos and walkthroughs of our AI products and AI\-assisted workflows (we will help you set up).
* Write LinkedIn posts, short blogs, and product explainers under our brand — including content on how we use Claude Code, Codex, and MCP in our stack.
* Build small demo notebooks and sandbox examples for sales conversations.
* Help prepare slides, one\-pagers, and visual content for prospect meetings.



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 



* **Strong hands\-on experience with LLM coding agents — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar.** 
 You should be able to talk in detail about projects you have built with them, prompts that worked, and prompts that did not.
* Solid Python fundamentals (functions, data structures, working with APIs, basic scripting).
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or open\-source models — beyond chatbot usage.
* Understanding of prompt engineering basics (system prompts, few\-shot examples, structured outputs).
* Clear written English — you will be writing posts and documentation.
* Curiosity, ownership, and willingness to learn fast in a remote setup.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Personal projects, hackathon entries, or GitHub repos built primarily with the help of Claude Code or Codex.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent frameworks, RAG, or tool calling.
* Exposure to LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar libraries.
* Comfort with making short screen\-recorded videos.
* Active LinkedIn presence, blog, or YouTube channel where you discuss AI tooling.
* AWS basics (even free\-tier experimentation counts).



  





**Who This Role Is NOT For** 



* Someone who has only used ChatGPT in the browser and not yet tried coding agents.
* Someone looking purely for a research or model\-training role.
* Someone uncomfortable being on camera or writing content.
* Someone who needs a structured corporate environment with daily managers — we are a startup and you will manage your own day.



  





**What We Offer** 



* 100% remote — work from anywhere in India.
* Direct mentorship from the founder (20\+ years in SAP/enterprise tech, published SAP Press author).
* Work in a fully AI\-native engineering environment — Claude Code, Codex, MCP, and modern agent tooling are part of daily life.
* Real exposure to building, testing, and selling AI products end\-to\-end.
* A chance to build your public profile through the content you produce.
* Fast growth path — strong performers will see salary revisions within 6–9 months.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your CV along with:
 


1. A short note (5–10 lines) on a project you have built
 **using Claude Code, Codex, or a similar coding agent** 
 — what you built, what worked, what surprised you.
2. Links to GitHub, LinkedIn, blog, or demo videos — anything that shows how you think and build.



 Bonus: a 2\-minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking through one AI project.

title: Service Reliability Engineer - General & Administrative Solutions Engineering
description:
**Summary**
 Do you have a passion for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of critical services? Are you a highly motivated and experienced engineer with a strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and a desire to automate and improve processes? Join Apple's General and Administrative (G\&A) Solutions Engineering team as a Service Reliability Engineer and play a vital role in supporting our global, mission\-critical production systems.
   

  

**Description**
 As a Service Reliability Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining the health, stability, and efficiency of our services, working with a diverse range of technologies and platforms. You will collaborate with Engineers, Data Engineers, DBAs, and network specialists to proactively identify and resolve potential issues, automate repetitive tasks, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Your expertise will directly impact the reliability of our systems, enabling Apple to deliver innovative products and services to our customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Proactively monitor service performance, identify potential bottlenecks, and implement solutions to optimize efficiency and resilience.
* Lead incident response efforts, driving rapid resolution and conducting thorough root cause analysis (RCA).
* Develop and implement automation strategies to streamline operational tasks, improve service resilience, and reduce manual intervention.
* Apply SRE principles to maintain highly reliable and scalable service infrastructure.
* Collaborate closely with development teams to ensure that new services are designed for operational excellence, incorporating best practices for monitoring, alerting, and scalability.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of comprehensive documentation, including run\-books, service level objectives (SLOs).
* Participate in on\-call rotations, providing 24/7 support for critical services and responding to incidents with a sense of urgency.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the service reliability team.
* Champion a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Define and track key service level indicators (SLIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) to measure and improve service reliability.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 0\-2 years of experience in a Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related role, supporting large\-scale, enterprise\-level services.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and scripting languages (e.g., Bash, PowerShell).
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud\-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog).
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues in distributed systems.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
* A passion for automation and a desire to continuously improve processes.
* Experience in RCA of technical issues.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience with database technologies (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL databases).
* Knowledge of ITIL frameworks and incident management processes.
* Experience with vibe coding
* Understanding of Linux/Unix system administration.
* Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet).

title: System & Network Administrator
description:
We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **System \& Network Administrator** to join our IT team. The candidate will be responsible for managing computer systems, servers, network infrastructure, and providing technical support to ensure smooth day\-to\-day IT operations within the organization. The ideal candidate should have basic knowledge of system administration, networking, troubleshooting, and IT support. Freshers who are passionate about IT Infrastructure, System Administration, and Networking are also welcome to apply.

**Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and maintain desktop systems, servers, and operating systems
* Monitor system and network performance to ensure smooth operations
* Configure and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, and network devices
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, system, and network\-related issues
* Manage user accounts, passwords, permissions, and access controls
* Perform regular backups, updates, patch management, and security checks
* Support LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, and internet connectivity
* Maintain IT infrastructure, system security, and network stability
* Provide technical support and desktop support to employees
* Ensure proper functioning of printers, office systems, and connected devices

**Skills Required**

* Basic knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, and system administration
* Familiarity with networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, and VPN
* Understanding of routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless networking
* Knowledge of Active Directory, Office 365, and user management
* Familiarity with hardware troubleshooting and desktop support
* Understanding of system and network security basics
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment

**Skillset**

System Administrator, Network Administrator, IT Support, Technical Support, Desktop Support, Windows Server, Linux Administration, Active Directory, Office 365, LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Firewall, Router Configuration, Switch Configuration, Network Troubleshooting, Hardware Troubleshooting, IT Infrastructure, Server Management, Network Security, System Monitoring, Help Desk Support, CCNA, RHCSA, Freshers IT Jobs

**Eligibility**

* Any Graduate / Diploma
* 0–2 years of experience
* Certifications like CCNA, RHCSA, MCSA, Network\+, or related courses are a plus

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
**About Persistent**
 We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

 Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026\.
   

  

**About Position**
* Role: Network Engineer
* Location: All Persistent Location
* Experience: 8\+ years
* Job Type: Full Time Employment


**What You'll Do**
* Design, implement, and operate enterprise LAN/WAN/WLAN and cloud\-connected networks.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, and network services (VLANs, STP, DHCP, DNS, NAT).
* Work on routing protocols and traffic engineering (BGP/OSPF), ensuring optimal paths and redundancy.
* Support cloud networking constructs such as VPC/VNet, subnets, gateways, load balancers, and connectivity (VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect).
* Monitor network performance, capacity, and availability; proactively address bottlenecks and failures.
* Implement and document network changes (CR/PR), standard operating procedures, and runbooks.
* Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams to enforce segmentation and security best practices.
* Participate in on call/incident response, RCA, and continuous improvements.


**Expertise You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise networking (routing/switching) and network troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of routing (BGP/OSPF), redundancy (HSRP/VRRP), and L2/L3 design patterns.
* Exposure to firewall/VPN fundamentals and network security controls (ACLs, segmentation).
* Working knowledge of cloud networking (AWS/Azure/GCP) and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with network monitoring and logging tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Grafana, Zabbix or equivalents).
* Ability to produce clear documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
* Preferred: Automation exposure (Python/Ansible), SD\-WAN, load balancers, or CDN basics.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering/computer science/IT or equivalent practical experience.


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents


**Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment**
 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
   

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**As a Network Security Operations** 
 Engineer, you will be responsible for providing operational security support across network environments, analysing security incidents and risks, and implementing protective controls to ensure the availability, integrity, and security of client networks.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Provide ongoing operational support and management of network environments, ensuring high availability, stability, and adherence to agreed service levels.
* Work closely with clients to understand operational requirements, business priorities, and network support needs, ensuring services align with day‑to‑day business operations.
* Perform regular health checks, audits, and operational reviews of network infrastructure to identify risks, incidents, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support and maintain network configurations, documentation, and operational runbooks, ensuring accuracy and readiness for operational and incident scenarios.
* Lead and participate in incident management, problem resolution, and root cause analysis for complex network issues, ensuring timely restoration and prevention of recurrence.
* Conduct network performance monitoring, capacity management, and utilization analysis to proactively address performance bottlenecks and scalability needs.
* Support change management activities, including validation, implementation, and post‑change monitoring, ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional operational teams (service desk, system administrators, security, and application teams) to deliver integrated and coordinated support.
* Apply operational best practices, standards, and compliance requirements to ensure process consistency and operational governance.
* Stay current with modern network technologies and operational trends, recommending improvements that enhance reliability, resilience, and operational efficiency.
* Provide day‑to‑day guidance and mentoring to junior engineers, supporting skill development, operational maturity, and knowledge transfer within the team.


**Requirements:**
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\-9 years of experience in network consulting, design, and implementation, preferably in a client\-facing role.
* Strong hands‑on experience with FireMon, Check Point firewalls, and Zscaler platforms in a network security operations environment.
* Proficient in network protocols and technologies such as TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs, VPNs, and firewalls.
* Strong expertise in modern network technologies, including but not limited to SD\-WAN, virtualization, cloud networking, software\-defined networking (SDN), and network automation.
* Hands\-on experience with network equipment from leading vendors, such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, etc.
* Expertise on Ansible for seamless automation of IP network configurations, optimizing the deployment and management of networking infrastructure.
* Expertise on Terraform to define and provision IP network resources, ensuring consistent and scalable network architectures.
* Proficient in cloud networking technologies and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Familiarity with network monitoring and management tools, such as Wireshark, SolarWinds, or Nagios.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex network requirements and propose effective solutions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of effectively presenting technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Industry certifications from vendors like Cisco, Juniper, Zscaler, Palo Alto, Fortinet etc. are highly desirable.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

 In addition to operational duties, you will contribute to service improvement by analyzing recurring issues and providing feedback and recommendations to help optimize network performance, reduce operational risk, and enhance overall service delivery. This includes identifying patterns, proposing configuration improvements, and collaborating with engineering and architecture teams. You will also mentor junior engineers and support knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  

 This position requires a blend of deep technical knowledge, strong analytical thinking, and effective communication skills. You will work closely with global teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure that DHL’s network infrastructure remains robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs.
   

  

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what you will do**
* Lead and coordinate incident resolution for Telecom infrastructure.
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for LAN, WAN (SDWAN, MPLS) \& WLAN.
* Provide interim and permanent solutions for business\-critical incidents.
* Analyze incident trends and network capacity for proactive planning.
* Participate in change management processes.
* Monitor and resolve infrastructure events impacting service quality.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers.
* Demonstrate ownership and accountability in all assigned tasks.
* Responsible for documentation and updating internal processes within the team.


**What you should have:**
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* 10 years of hands\-on experience in Telecoms or Network Operations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Fluent in English (spoken and written).
* CCNP Network Certification.
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, Cisco switching/routing, and wireless LAN.
* Familiarity with firewall (FW), intrusion prevention (NIPS), F5 load balancing and Proxy.
* Excellent communication, prioritization, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* ITIL Foundation.


**An array of benefits for you:**
* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in\-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self \+ Spouse \+ 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent \-in\-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem\-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross\-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
   

  

 In this role, you will be a part of a Global team that provides support to help customers switch to Google Cloud. You will troubleshoot technical issues for customers with debugging, networking, system administration, documentation updating, and coding/scripting. You will make the products easier to adopt and to use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes, and documentation. You will help drive business growth of Google Cloud by recognizing and advocating for the customer issues.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Manage the customers issues through diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Develop knowledge of Google's product technology and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, planning the root cause for customer reported issues, and building tools for diagnosis.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, business, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment issues and improve Google Cloud.
* Understand customer issues and advocate for their needs with cross\-functional teams including Product and Engineering teams to find ways to improve the product, and drive production.
* Work as part of a team of engineers or consultants that ensure customer support globally. Work non\-standard hours/shifts as needed.
