title: Human Resources Associate - Benefits
description:
:
**ZS** is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side\-by\-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life\-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client\-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life\-changing impact to ZS.

  


 :
**Human Resources** develops and executes successful recruiting programs, learning and expertise\-development initiatives, strategic staffing assignments, effective reporting and analytics, performance management processes, and work\-life benefits and operations. **HR Associate \-** **Benefits** **What** **you’ll** **do****:**

* Execute day\-to\-day benefits administration tasks, including employee data changes, enrollments, eligibility updates, and life event processing, in accordance with established procedures
* Support ongoing benefits operations by handling high\-volume, transactional activities efficiently and accurately
* Perform routine audits and reconciliations to ensure data integrity between Benefits systems, Payroll, and HR systems
* Support efforts to standardize, streamline, and document global benefits processes
* Assist with the transition of manual or repetitive tasks into automated or semi\-automated workflows
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, or recurring issues and escalate recommendations for improvement
* Partner closely with the Payroll team to support benefits\-related payroll inputs, deductions, and issue resolution
* Coordinate with the India\-based Benefits team member to ensure smooth handoffs and clear ownership of tasks
* Respond to internal inquiries related to benefits operations, routing complex questions to senior team members as appropriate
* Maintain process documentation, job aids, and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Track and report on operational metrics such as turnaround times, error rates, and volume trends
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, compliance requirements, and data privacy standards

**What** **you’ll** **bring****:*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 1–3 years of experience in HR Operations, Benefits Administration, Payroll, or an HR shared services environment
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage high\-volume of work
* Comfort working with HRIS, payroll systems, and Excel or similar tools
* Ability to follow standardized processes while identifying opportunities for improvement
* Fluency in English
* Client\-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem\-solving approach


 :
**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s\-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

 **Perks \& Benefits:**


At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations \| Where we work \| ZS.  



**Hybrid working model:**


We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on\-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face\-to\-face connections.

 **Travel:**


Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client\-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. description:
Job Title: Payroll Specialist II



Location: India (Remote)



Shift: 4:30PM to 1:30 AM


**About Us**



HighLevel is an AI powered, all\-in\-one white\-label sales \& marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2\.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.


**Our People**



With over 1,500 team members across 15\+ countries, we operate in a global, remote\-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.


**Who You Are**



We are looking for a **Payroll Specialist II** to join our Payroll team and support our growing international workforce. This role is a great opportunity for someone early in their career or someone who is looking to re\-enter the workforce after a career break. We are seeking a candidate who is eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to global payroll operations and compliance. You will play a key role in ensuring employees across countries like the United States, India, Mexico, and the Philippines are paid accurately based on their time worked, including overtime, shift premiums, and other pay rules. If you enjoy problem\-solving, working with data, and learning how systems and processes come together this role is for you.


**What You’ll Do**


**Time \& Attendance Operations**



You will serve as a key administrator for our time tracking systems, preserving the integrity of our global workforce data. Your day\-to\-day will involve auditing employee time entries for accuracy and completeness. When issues arise—such as missing punches, timecard discrepancies, or pending manager approvals—you will be the go\-to person to resolve them, ensuring a seamless flow of data.


**Support Global Payroll Excellence**



You will support our global payroll cycles by validating time data before it is processed. This includes ensuring employees are compensated correctly based on different factors, including total hours worked, complex overtime rules, and various shift differentials like night shift premiums.


**Compliance \& Global Pay Rules**



In this role, you will become an expert in the labor requirements of multiple regions. You will learn and support the specific time tracking and pay rules for the US, Mexico, Philippines, and India, assisting the team in maintaining strict compliance with local labor laws and internal policies.


**Empower Teams through Training \& Support**



You will act as the face of time and attendance for our staff. From supporting the onboarding of new hires to coordinating training sessions for managers, you’ll teach teams how to navigate our systems—covering everything from the basics of clocking in and out to the nuances of pay rules. You will serve as a dedicated point of contact for any attendance\-related inquiries.


**Drive Systems \& Process Improvement**



We believe in constant evolution. You will partner with Payroll and HR teams to identify bottlenecks and improve our time tracking workflows. Whether you are testing and implementing new system updates or collaborating with external vendors to enhance configurations, your input will help scale our operations.


**Deliver Reporting \& Strategic Insights**



Your work will provide the data\-driven insights needed for leadership to make informed decisions. You will assist in preparing comprehensive reports on overtime trends, attendance patterns, and exceptions. Additionally, you will play a supportive role in audits and internal reviews, ensuring our records remain "audit\-ready" at all times.


**What You Bring**


* 2 years of experience in Payroll, HR Operations, or data/process roles
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Experience working with systems, data, and spreadsheets
* Comfortable with international payroll nuances and time\-tracking systems.
* Strong communication skills for interacting with global stakeholders.• High attention to detail and ability to work independently during the evening shift.

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. * Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

title: HCM Solution and Integration Architect
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

**About the role**


The Solution \& Integrations Architect will play a critical architecture leadership role within the HR Technology portfolio, with a core focus on simplifying the overall solution architecture and integration landscape. This role sits in the Corporate Functions D\&T organization and reports to the Director of HCM DevOps.


This role is responsible for shaping, governing, and evolving HR technology solutions by applying enterprise architecture principles, capability led design, and platform first thinking. The architect will provide clear, evidence\-based guidance on what systems and products should be used for which HR business capabilities—and why, ensuring long\-term scalability, reduced complexity, and improved employee and manager experience.


Deep, hands\-on experience with HCM suite of products is essential, as these platforms form the backbone of the HR systems landscape.

**Role Responsibilities**

* Own and define end\-to\-end solution architectures for HR capabilities across the employee lifecycle, ensuring alignment to enterprise and HR target architectures.
* Apply business capability\-based architecture to determine system fit, avoid duplication, and guide investment decisions.
* Lead the rationalisation of the HR integration landscape, reducing point\-to\-point complexity and improving reusability and resilience.
* Define and govern integration patterns, standards, and principles (e.g., event based, API\-led, canonical data models).
* Act as a trusted architecture authority on Workday and other HCM capabilities, constraints, and best fit use cases.
* Guide decisions on where to standardise vs. extend, and when not to customise.
* Serve as a key contributor to architecture governance forums, design reviews, and investment discussions.
* Provide clear, defensible recommendations to senior HR, Digital, and Architecture stakeholders—grounded in principles, not preferences.
* Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture guardrails, data principles (e.g., FAIR), and regulatory expectations (e.g., SOX where applicable).
* Maintain architectural artefacts in enterprise repositories (e.g., capability maps, solution views, spider diagrams, integration diagrams).
* Collaborate with HR Product Owners, Business Partners, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Security, and external vendors.
* Translate complex architectural topics into clear, business relevant narratives for senior stakeholders (e.g., CHRO\-level discussions).
* Influence delivery partners to build simpler, more sustainable solutions, not just technically correct ones.

***Why you?***

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 12\-14 years of experience in solution and/or integration architecture, with significant exposure to complex HR technology landscapes.
* Deep hands\-on experience with Workday and other HCM Tools (Core HR, Talent, Learning, Integrations).
* Strong grounding in enterprise architecture principles, including capability modelling, platform strategy, and technology lifecycle management.
* Proven experience simplifying large, fragmented integration landscapes in a global enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of HR data domains, integration patterns, and downstream consumers (analytics, payroll, identity, learning, etc.).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within global, regulated enterprises with strong governance expectations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow HRSD, IAM/PAM, data platforms, or integration middleware.
* Experience contributing to or operating within a formal architecture governance model.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture thinking with pragmatic delivery realities.
* Systems thinker with a strong bias for simplification and clarity
* Comfortable challenging “because we always did it this way”
* Trusted advisor who can influence without authority
* Able to operate at both deep technical and executive narrative levels
* Values long\-term architectural health over short\-term fixes

  

**Job Posting End Date**

-----------------------


Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

----------------------------------------


If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

----------------------


The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
About HireRight:

We empower organizations around the world to hire with precision and act with confidence. As a global leader in background screening and workforce intelligence, we combine smart technology, human expertise, and a passion for delivering speed and accuracy to create a seamless experience for both employers and candidates. Headquartered in Nashville, TN, and operating in over 200 countries and territories, we’re proud to help millions of people get hired — the right way.


Overview:

We are seeking a high‑impact HR Business Partner who is not only a strategic thought partner but also exceptionally strong with numbers, analytics, and business insights. This individual will play a critical role in shaping people strategy in India, driving organizational transformation, and enabling business performance across global teams.

  

The ideal candidate is business‑savvy, highly analytical, action‑oriented, comfortable making decisions, and skilled at navigating complex stakeholder relationships while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

  

This role partners closely with business leadership as an HRBP and additionally oversees select site responsibilities related to workplace governance and employee experience.


Responsibilities:
**Key Outcomes**

* Strategic \& Analytical Impact: HR strategies informed by deep data insights and business metrics, resulting in measurable improvements in productivity, talent health, and organizational performance.
* Leadership Influence: Strong advisory capabilities with senior leaders, backed by clear data storytelling and evidence‑based recommendations.
* Change Leadership: Successful execution of organizational change initiatives with agility, clarity, and stakeholder alignment.
* Operational Excellence: High‑quality delivery of global HR programs with local relevance – on time, with discipline, and with a focus on measurable outcomes.
* Employee Experience: Strengthened engagement and improved retention through proactive interventions grounded in data and business acumen.

**Core Competencies**

* Ownership \& Accountability: Critical for the role
* Employee Relations \& Employment Law Acumen: Demonstrates strong working knowledge of local labour laws and applies it to manage complex ER matters
* Business Acumen \& Financial Understanding – Connects business metrics (revenue, productivity, cost drivers) with people strategies; translates data into actionable decisions.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making – Strong ability to analyze workforce data, identify trends, diagnose issues, and propose data‑backed recommendations.
* Influencing \& Stakeholder Management – Builds trust, manages senior stakeholders effectively, and drives alignment across global teams.
* Change Leadership – Leads transformation initiatives with clarity, structure, and measurable outcomes.
* Execution \& Action Orientation – Moves quickly from insight to action, makes informed decisions, and manages multiple projects with precision.
* Cultural Intelligence – Navigates global and local cultural nuances to design inclusive and impactful HR solutions.
* Prioritization \& Multitasking – Manages high volumes of work and parallel projects without compromising quality.

  


Qualifications:
**Experience \& Knowledge*** Proven experience as an HR Business Partner in a global matrix environment.
* Hands‑on experience in talent management, workforce planning, organizational design, performance management, and change management.
* Demonstrated ability to use analytics, dashboards, and data tools to diagnose challenges and influence decisions.
* Strong understanding of global HR practices, local compliance, and evolving workforce trends.

 **Measures of Success**

* Improvement in business performance indicators tied to HR interventions.
* Strong leadership advocacy and trust reflected through feedback and collaboration outcomes.
* Increased employee sentiment, stronger inclusion markers, and reduced regrettable attrition.
* Effective local deployment of global HR initiatives with minimal rework and strong stakeholder alignment.
* Timely delivery and quality of multiple HR projects and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to make fast, informed decisions with clear rationale.

 **Qualifications and Requirements**

* 7\-10\+ years of progressive HR experience in a global or matrixed HRBP role.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem‑solving skills; ability to interpret and act on data.
* Proven capability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives.
* Experience in organizational design, talent management, and leading change.
* Excellent communication skills, including data‑backed storytelling.
* Ability to operate in a fast‑moving, deadline‑driven environment while managing multiple priorities.
* High degree of ownership, decision‑making ability, and action orientation.


What do we offer:

Please submit resume/CV in English.  

All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.  

  

HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience working within a network operations environment.

**About The Job**
 Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.
   

  

 Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Monitor network dashboards and alerting systems (e.g., IRM) for anomalies and performance issues. Perform initial triage of alerts, classifying severity and potential impact based on playbooks.
* Troubleshoot and resolve network incidents of low to moderate complexity affecting wired and wireless networks, routing, switching, firewalls, etc. Open and manage tickets with vendors (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto) and Internet Service Providers (ISPs).
* Manage user\-reported network issues submitted via the ticketing system. Resolve tickets within SLOs, ensuring clear documentation of troubleshooting steps and resolutions.
* Implement routine and low\-impact network changes following approved Change Requests (CRs) and MOPs. This could include tasks like port configurations, VLAN assignments, or software updates on single devices.
* Maintain and update network diagrams and operational documentation. Participate in network health checks and audits.

title: Patient Safety Physician
description:
**Key Accountabilities:**

 **General**

* Maintaining a good working knowledge of the Adverse event/Safety profile of assigned products, labeling documents, data handling conventions, client’s guidelines and procedures, and global drug safety regulations and guidelines
* Maintaining an awareness of global regulatory requirements, reporting obligations and organizing workload to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory timelines for adverse event reporting
* Communicating and discussing issues related to review process with Line Manager/ Project Leader/Designee
* Interacting with internal and external stakeholders for resolving issues under guidance of senior physicians.
* Attending and/ or presenting at client/cross functional meetings along with other stakeholders under guidance of senior physicians.
* Developing knowledge of global regulatory requirements and reporting obligations

**Case report medical review (as applicable)**

* Performing medical review of cases not limited to (including non\-serious and serious spontaneous (including legal cases), clinical trial, and literature cases including combination products {drug\-device) according to established client/Parexel Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs; as applicable) and liaising with the client under supervision
* Writing Pharmacovigilance/Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) comment and assessing company causality
* Review appropriateness of medical content in narrative for medical coherence
* Assessing seriousness, listedness / expectedness of reported events.
* Providing medical inputs to case processing team
* Raising appropriate follow\-up queries for relevant information from the reporter/HCP (Health Care Professional)
* Review and verify appropriate selection of adverse events from source documents, assign appropriate Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) code, review narrative
* Identify and resolve case issues, coordinate with client therapeutic/legal team under supervision

**Periodic reports (as applicable)**

* Reviewing and/ or authoring of aggregate reports for medical content and consistency in accordance with client requirements and SOPs
* Providing medical inputs into, and supporting the preparation of key regulatory documents including but not limited to, Periodic Benefit\-Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRERs)/ Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs), Signal Evaluation Reports (SERs), Health Authority (HA) response documents, Development Safety Update Reports (DSURs), Clinical Overviews (COs), Addendum to Clinical Overview (ACOs), Health Hazard Evaluation reports (HHEs), etc.
* Clinical Expert Statements and other documents as required

**Medical monitoring (as applicable)**

* Answering day\-to\-day medical and scientific questions, provide daily medical support to Parexel staff or site (investigator/study coordinator), under supervision
* Review adverse events report for accuracy and clinical importance, relationship to the study drug as well as for severity and seriousness; provide sponsors with periodic experience reports summarizing adverse events as required by the sponsor or authorities
* Attend and present material (such as therapeutic area training), as requested, at internal and external meetings (such as investigator meetings)
* Provide medical safety expertise to client under supervision
* Review Data Management line listings (including adverse events, laboratory data, vital signs data, medical history, physical examination, concomitant medication, efficacy end points), establish the presence or absence of clinically meaningful trends and, if noted, follow up as appropriate with the project team, sponsor, investigator.
* Review technical documents written by Parexel with respect to medically relevant matters with particular attention to those relating to patient safety
* Review coding of adverse events, medical history and concomitant medications for accuracy and consistency
* Review of patient profile report as needed
* Provide support for the preparation of clinical protocols, integrated clinical and statistical summary reports, journal articles, and other documents for clients/sponsors in conjunction with clients/sponsors or in conjunction with other Parexel departments
* Attend and present material as requested, at internal and external meetings (e.g., investigator meetings, therapeutic area training, Regulatory Authority meetings) under guidance from senior physician

**Literature review (as applicable)**

* Review of literature for product safety assessment and potential safety issues
* Expert in reviewing literature references including triaging, summarizing and providing MAH comments for aggregate reports and for various signal management activities

**CSR Narratives (as applicable)**

* Performing medical review of Clinical study report narratives according to the client’s guidelines and SOPs

**Provide medical guidance to PV team/study team**

* Provide medical guidance to safety staff during the case processing cycle
* Provide input as necessary to Feasibility Studies, Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs), Clinical Endpoint Committees (CECs)
* Provide medical input into Pharmacovigilance workflows and projects under guidance

**Signal Detection and Management (as applicable)**

* Supporting signal detection activities under supervision in accordance with client conventions/SOPs and within pre\-decided timeframes. Perform medical assessment of safety alerts obtained from data mining activities.
* Perform signal validation activities under supervision
* Support preparation of SERs, perform case analysis, review literature summaries, check draft for medical and scientific accuracy and cohesiveness
* Support responses to HA requests and other safety documents
* Providing relevant medical inputs to Medical Writers (MWs) authoring SERs, Signal validations etc.
* Managing safety signals on project specific tools (e.g., Signal Tracking System, Signal management tools, etc.).
* Attend Safety Management Team (SMT) meetings present data/analysis under supervision.

**Skills:**

* Experience in clinical medicine (general or specialist qualifications) which is expected to be kept up to date
* Ability to work within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action
* Developing knowledge of drug safety, clinical trial and pharmacovigilance principles
* Good presentation and verbal/written communication skills.

* Computer proficiency, ability to work with web\-based applications and familiarity with the Windows operating system and Microsoft Office apps.
* A flexible attitude with respect to work assignments and new learnings.
* Good understanding of international drug regulation including ICH GCP, GVP, and all other applicable regulations and guidelines.

**Knowledge and Experience**:


* Experience in pharmacovigilance and medical data review activities is desirable but not essential
* Good knowledge/understanding of medical terminology.
* Fresher/ relevant experience in pharmacovigilance/ Drug Safety/clinical practice.

**Education:**

description:
**Associate STEM Content Analyst \- GENESEQ Indexing**


We are looking for an Associate STEM Content Analyst to join GENESEQ team (Intellectual Property) in Chennai. This is an amazing opportunity to deliver value\-add scientific information for GENESEQ™ Indexing product which is a proprietary database to easily search and identify biological sequences covered in patent. The team consists of 40 plus colleagues. We have a great skill set in biotechnology, genetics, and molecular biology concepts to curate biological sequence information, and we would love to speak with you if you have skills in comprehensive knowledge in the respective technology domain.

**About You**

* Must be a master’s degree graduate in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Microbiology, Genetics, Molecular Biology, and Biochemistry
* Can be a fresher or candidate with around 1 year experience in working on patents, patent indexing with basic patent knowledge.
* If experienced, must have at least a year’s experience in patent indexing, disease indexing, abstract writing

 **It would be great if you also had . . .**

* 1 to 2 years of experience on patent indexing, gene sequencing, genetics, and disease indexing
* Good knowledge on computer including MS office, PDF or TIFF images; good exposure to publicly available databases like NCBI taxonomy database, PubMed, etc; and secondary research skills.

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* You will Apply biotechnology, genetics, and molecular biology concepts to curate biological sequence related information from patent documents in line with editorial policies and conventions.
* Indexers manually curate all biological sequences given in the specification, including those found within PDF or TIFF images, not just those given in the formal electronic sequence listing.
* Indexers also create additional sequences which are described in the specification, which often are not given in the sequence listing, but which are claimed. The team will also create individual records for mutated sequences and for claimed SEQ ID fragments where the whole sequence has not been claimed.
* Achieve weekly production volume and quality targets and to maintain the consistency.
* To make positive efforts to promote personal safety and that of others by taking reasonable care at work, by carrying out the requirements of the law or following recognized codes of practice provided or advised by management to ensure safe working practices.

 **GENESEQ** Team is one of the key knowledge\-driven teams in Intellectual Property Group in Clarivate. title: QC Executive ( Injection Molding)
description:
Quality Control (QC) Executive / Inspector Job Description

Industry: Plastic Parts Manufacturing – Injection Molding Job Title: Quality Control (QC) Executive / QC Inspector Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control Location: Chhatral Reporting To: Quality Manager / Production Head

Key Responsibilities

1\. Incoming Material Inspection  Check and inspect incoming raw materials, master batches, inserts, and packing materials.  Verify material quality as per approved standards and specifications.  Maintain proper inspection records and reports.

2\. In\-Process Quality Inspection  Conduct regular inspection during production on Injection Molding Machines.  Ensure products are manufactured according to approved drawings, samples, and customer requirements.  Monitor dimensions, appearance, weight, color, finish, and fitting of plastic parts.  Identify production defects such as: o Short molding o Flash o Black spots o Sink marks o Flow marks o Color variation o Burr o Crack o Warpage o Burn marks o Silver marks  Take immediate corrective action with production team when defects are found.

3\. Final Inspection \& Dispatch Clearance  Perform final inspection of finished goods before dispatch.  Approve only quality\-approved material for packing and dispatch.  Ensure proper labeling and packing standards are followed.  Prepare final inspection reports and maintain dispatch quality records.

4\. Measurement \& Testing  Use measuring instruments such as: o Vernier Caliper o Micrometer o Height Gauge o Weighing Scale o Plug Gauge / Go\-No\-Go Gauge  Maintain calibration status of measuring instruments.  Record measurement results accurately.

5\. Documentation \& Reporting  Maintain daily quality inspection reports.  Prepare rejection and rework reports.  Maintain quality check sheets and production quality records.  Update management regarding quality issues and rejection percentages. Support ISO and customer audit documentation.

6\. Problem Solving \& Improvement  Analyze root causes of defects and quality issues.  Coordinate with Production, Tool Room, and Maintenance departments for corrective actions.  Suggest improvements for reducing rejection and improving product quality.  Participate in continuous improvement activities.

7\. Customer Quality Compliance  Ensure products meet customer quality standards and specifications.  Handle customer complaints related to product quality.  Support corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities.

Required Skills  Good knowledge of Injection Molding process.  Knowledge of plastic part defects and quality standards.  Ability to read drawings and inspection parameters.  Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word).  Good observation and reporting skills.  Attention to detail and problem\-solving ability.  Ability to work in shifts if required.

Qualification  Diploma / ITI / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Plastic Engineering, or relevant field.  Experience in Plastic Injection Molding Quality preferred. Experience  Fresher or Experienced candidates can apply.2\-3 years  Minimum \_\_\_\_\_\_ years of experience preferred in plastic manufacturing quality inspection.

Working Conditions  Factory manufacturing environment.  Standing and inspection work during production shifts.  Rotational shifts may be applicable.

Salary \& Benefits  Salary: Open Budget (Depends on Interview)  Opportunities for career growth and skill development.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)  Reduction in rejection percentage.  Accuracy in inspection and reporting.  Customer complaint reduction.  On\-time quality clearance.  Maintaining quality documentation properly.

**Description**
 Within the Selection Monitoring team, a Business analyst is expected to own analytics on large volumes of data, synthesize the analysis into business insights, communicate the findings to stakeholders and and deliver business value. Business analyst will be expected to be skilled in understanding customer needs, converting them to analysis requirements, having working knowledge of data availability in various sources, building customer confidence through effective communication and derive recommendations. Business analyst would also be responsible for the project plan, cost and efficiency analytics platform resources, scaling of data processes and reports, and project timeline and deliverables.

* Solve ambiguous problems with less well\-defined inputs and outputs; drive to the heart of the problem and identify root causes
* Identify, develop and execute data analysis to uncover areas of business opportunities
* Learn and understand the broad range of Amazon’s data resources and develop knowledge of how, when and which data sources to use

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, engineering , analytics, mathematics, statistics or a related technical or quantitative field
